key_insight: Missing safety-critical facts can cause tool-using LLM agents to execute prohibited actions even when user requests are benign and all returned statements are true.
engineering_relevance: Agent safety evaluation should test incomplete tool responses and verify that agents obtain missing evidence before deciding whether to act.
method: Evaluate 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains.
Systematically suppress critical facts and measure unsafe execution and minimum observed failure cardinality.
Provide an independent audit tool to test evidence acquisition, withholding prohibited actions, and completing permissible tasks.
evidence_signal: Across ten models, recovery access reduced unsafe execution for every model, but evidence acquisition and appropriate action varied substantially.
watch_item: Resistance to missing evidence does not guarantee useful recovery; audit-tool access must be evaluated separately from whether agents actually seek and correctly use missing facts.
paper_title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
